rows.name: Hall Effect/Rapid Trigger
rows.note: Keychron's V6 Ultra Hybrid Kickstarter (mechanical + magnetic switches on one board) launched Aug 18 and hit 569% of its $30k goal within 48 hours, reinforcing HE's mainstream pull.

rows.name: Cherry MX2A
rows.note: MX2A remains the default across Cherry's retail lineup, but the China-made Lumina Browns keep drawing stem-wobble and consistency complaints with no official response yet.

rows.name: Gateron Magnetic Jade Emerald
rows.note: The first tactile magnetic switch keeps its strong reception into a second week, with reviewers citing a crisp bump and software-adjustable actuation point.

rows.name: Durock T1
rows.note: No fresh catalyst this week — T1 remains the default stepped-tactile pick, still cited alongside Holy Pandas in mid-2026 buyer's guides.

rows.name: Gateron Oil King
rows.note: Oil King grew from a single linear switch into a full series — Linear Silent, Tactile Silent, and Heavy Tactile variants — with some retailers still on backorder.

rows.name: GMK CYL Orange Alert
rows.note: Group buy remains mid-run through Sep 14 across Divinikey, KBDfans, UniKeys and Keebz N Cables, with estimated shipping now pegged to February 2027.

rows.name: GMK CYL TA Neo
rows.note: Fully in post-buy production tracking with estimated ship pushed to Nov-Dec; chatter keeps cooling as attention shifts to newer GMK CYL buys.

rows.name: DCS Dolch / Molch
rows.note: With sibling set Molch's buy also closed, the Dolch family has moved into a quieter post-buy holding pattern and lost last week's fresh-close bump.

rows.name: GMK CYL OG Extensions
rows.note: Availability is split rather than cleanly restocked — NovelKeys shows sold out with a restock signup, while Prototypist and zFrontier list it in stock.

rows.name: Split/Ergo layout
rows.note: Keychron's fully wireless Q11 Ultra is drawing strong reviews this week, with a 300-hour battery claim and 8K polling praised as a step forward for split boards.

rows.name: Alice layout
rows.note: Keychron shipped two new Alice boards this week, the B40 75% and B39 1800 with numpad, both scissor-switch and ZMK — a concrete bounce after weeks of ground lost to full split.

rows.name: 75% Layout
rows.note: Still the dominant form factor for hybrid WFH/gaming setups, cited near 42% share of custom-keyboard community preference; no new catalyst this week.

rows.name: Mode Designs
rows.note: Encore's refresh brings a new crown mounting system co-designed with Matthew Encina, Monterey and Cacao colorways are fulfilling, and Prologue keeps moving.

rows.name: CannonKeys
rows.note: Picture stays mixed rather than simply declining — Blaine V2: SE is closed and sold out, but GMK Finer Things R2 and MW Norse buys wrapped alongside new preorders opening.

rows.name: Prototypist
rows.note: SF60 HE group buy continues tracking toward a Q1 2027 ship; no new milestone this week, still the vendor's flagship item in the pipeline.

rows.name: Keychron
rows.note: V6 Ultra Hybrid's Kickstarter hit 569% of goal in 48 hours, the B39/B40 Alice boards shipped, and Q11 Ultra reviews are glowing — the broadest single-week brand presence on the tracker.

rows.name: Cherry (MX + XTRFY)
rows.note: Lumina Brown quality complaints persist without an official response, further eroding goodwill built by MX2A's smoother, more consistent switches.

rows.name: Topre / HHKB
rows.note: Realforce R4's dual-mode USB-C/Bluetooth model is an established SKU from its Japan launch, not an upcoming one as previously framed; no fresh R4 news this week.
